evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Deep semantic understanding of events requires recognizing related events and distinguishing why an event occurs from how it is carried out. 5W1H extraction provides a structured foundation for such understanding by organizing event information around six fundamental questions.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: A shared document encoder provides evidence for joint 4W refinement, and two separate sets of boundary and role-scoring heads then extract why and how under event-specific constraints, respectively.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: We select nine of the resulting datasets to evaluate ANCHOR against strong baselines using four open-weight LLMs.
